title: invincibletimemanager
description: Creates and manages a datapack tag that removes invulnerability time for selected damage types.
body:
# 📦 Invincible Time Manager

> Control invincibility frames (cooldown) for each damage type in
> Minecraft

## 📖 Overview

**Invincible Time Manager** is a Fabric mod that allows players to
control the invincibility time (cooldown / i-frames) applied after
taking damage.

This mod works by modifying the `minecraft:bypasses_cooldown` tag,
allowing specific damage types to bypass or respect invincibility
frames.

## ⚙️ Features

-   Control invincibility per damage type
-   Automatic datapack generation
-   Real-time reload support
-   Lightweight Fabric-only mod
-   Command-based configuration system
-   Internal cache system

## 🧠 How It Works

Minecraft uses the `bypasses_cooldown` tag.

Damage types inside this tag: → Ignore invincibility frames

This mod dynamically edits that tag via datapacks.

## 📂 Generated Files

### Datapack Location

`<world>`{=html}/datapacks/invincibletimemanager/

### Files

-   pack.mcmeta
-   data/minecraft/tags/damage_type/bypasses_cooldown.json

### Cache

.minecraft/moddata/invincibletimemanager/damage_types.json

## 🕹️ Commands

/invincibletimemanager /invincibletimemanager version
/invincibletimemanager help /invincibletimemanager reset
/invincibletimemanager add `<damage_type>`{=html} /invincibletimemanager
delete `<damage_type>`{=html} /invincibletimemanager list
/invincibletimemanager reload

## ⚠️ Notes

-   Can significantly affect gameplay balance
-   Test before using in multiplayer
-   Some damage types may behave differently depending on version

## 🧪 Example

/invincibletimemanager add minecraft:lava

## 🧾 Compatibility

-   Minecraft: 1.19.4
-   Loader: Fabric
-   Environment: Singleplayer

## 🐞 Known Issues

-   Duplicate commands may exist (no functional impact)
-   Some errors may not appear in logs
